staking_rules.each_way: £1 win + £1 place. 1/5 place terms: place profit = (advised odds - 1) / 5. Won pays both, Top N pays place only.
staking_rules.place_lay: £1 place lay. Won/Top N = -(advised odds / 5), otherwise +1.

summary.note: Generic Win Value rows are excluded. Only visible Today Bet & Lay shortlist bet classes are tracked.
